rows.name: split-builder
rows.source: import {query,action} from "./_generated/server";export const split=query({args:{},handler:async(context)=>{const builder=context.db.query("rows");return builder.collect();}});export const positive=query({args:{},handler:async(context)=>context.db.query("other").collect()});
rows.limit: The split builder collect is not followed. The separate direct collect remains visible.

rows.name: custom-registration
rows.limit: Custom factory wrapper return identity is unresolved; if it delegates to query the collect is missed. The direct neighbor remains visible.

rows.name: stored-then-awaited-loop
rows.source: import {query,action} from "./_generated/server";export const f=action({args:{},handler:async(context)=>{for(const id of ids){const pending=context.runQuery(internal.rows.get,{id});await pending;}for(const id of ids){await context.runQuery(internal.rows.get,{id});}}});
rows.limit: Only direct awaited calls are followed; the stored-then-awaited loop is a known missed sequential observation.
